ei.title: The Human Mind as a Weapon
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.

questions.passage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that (A)[competition / cooperation] and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, (B)[lacked / possessed] a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to (C)[imagine / forget] and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① competition — possessed — imagine: 원문 일치. 다른 부족과의 경쟁(competition)이 뇌를 진화시켰고, 더 잘 생각하는 부족이 중요한 이점을 지녔으며(possessed), 적의 공격을 상상하고(imagine) 예측하는 능력이 이점을 준다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② cooperation — possessed — imagine: (A) cooperation(협력)은 '경쟁(competition)과 갈등'이라는 맥락과 다름
❌ ③ competition — lacked — imagine: (B) lacked(부족했다)는 이점을 '지녔다(possessed)'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ competition — possessed — forget: (C) forget(잊다)은 적의 공격을 '상상한다(imagine)'는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: competition and conflicts(경쟁과 갈등) / possessed a vital advantage(중요한 이점을 지녔다) / imagine and predict(상상하고 예측하다)

The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more (C)[decisive / useless] than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① friendly — significant — decisive: (A) friendly(우호적인)는 '적대적인(hostile)' 적 부족이라는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② hostile — trivial — decisive: (B) trivial(사소한)은 '중요한(significant)' 군사적 이점이라는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ hostile — significant — decisive: 원문 일치. 적대적인(hostile) 적 부족, 중요한(significant) 군사적 이점, 그 어떤 것보다 결정적인(decisive) 무기라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ hostile — significant — useless: (C) useless(쓸모없는)는 '결정적인(decisive)' 무기라는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: a hostile enemy tribe(적대적인 적 부족) / a significant military advantage(중요한 군사적 이점) / far more decisive(훨씬 더 결정적인)

questions.passage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the (A)[struggle / comfort] for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to (B)[fail / succeed] in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the (C)[descendants / ancestors] of the winners.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① comfort — succeed — descendants: (A) comfort(안락)는 생존을 위한 '투쟁(struggle)'이라는 맥락과 다름
❌ ② struggle — fail — descendants: (B) fail(실패하다)은 전투에서 '성공한다(succeed)'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ struggle — succeed — ancestors: (C) ancestors(조상)는 승자의 '후손(descendants)'이라는 맥락과 반대
✅ ④ struggle — succeed — descendants: 원문 일치. 생존을 위한 투쟁(struggle), 전투에서 성공할(succeed) 가능성, 승자의 후손(descendants)이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: the struggle for survival(생존을 위한 투쟁) / succeed in battle(전투에서 성공하다) / the descendants of the winners(승자의 후손)

det.korean: ② minor(사소한) → vital(중요한): 더 잘 생각하는 부족은 '중요한' 이점을 지녔다는 맥락
det.analysis:

✅ ③ predict — 원문 일치. 적의 공격을 예측한다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ strike — 원문 일치. 적 부족이 공격할 수 있다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: possessed a vital advantage — 중요한 이점을 지녔다

det.tip: mind: ① (명사) 정신/마음 ② (동사) 꺼리다/신경 쓰다 (Would you mind ~?)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "an object such as a gun or knife that is used to hurt or defeat people in a fight or war"

det.korean: weapon=무기 (싸움이나 전쟁에서 사람을 다치게 하거나 이기는 데 쓰는 물건)
det.analysis:
❌ ① shield: shield(방패)는 공격이 아닌 방어 도구로 정의와 다름
✅ ② weapon: weapon(무기)은 싸움·전쟁에서 상대를 해치거나 이기는 데 쓰는 물건으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ tool: tool(도구)은 일반 작업 도구로 '싸움·전쟁'이라는 조건과 다름
❌ ④ shelter: shelter(피난처)는 보호 장소로 정의와 다름
det.tip: weapon = 무기. used to hurt or defeat in a fight or war가 핵심

questions.passage: A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, __________ (possession) a vital advantage over others. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan accordingly, gives your tribe a significant military advantage.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 주어 A human tribe의 본동사 자리(과거): 명사 possession → 동사 possessed
det.analysis: 주어 'A human tribe'의 본동사 자리이며 과거의 일이므로, 명사 possession을 동사의 과거형 possessed로 바꿔야 한다. 'possessed a vital advantage'(중요한 이점을 지녔다). possession → possessed
det.tip: 명사 possession → 동사 possess → 과거형 possessed

questions.passage: This mental advantage was __________ (apply), over and over, within each succeeding generation of the tribe. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'This mental advantage was __________'은 수동태 'be + 과거분사(p.p.)' 구조이다. 이점은 '적용되는' 대상이므로 수동태 과거분사 applied가 적절. apply → applied
det.tip: 수동태 be + p.p.: was applied = 적용되었다

questions.passage: How did the human mind evolve? One possibility is that competition and conflicts with other human tribes caused our brains to evolve the way they did. A human tribe that could out-think its enemies, even slightly, possessed a vital advantage. The ability of your tribe to imagine and predict where and when a hostile enemy tribe might strike, and plan __________, gives your tribe a significant military advantage. The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. The tribe that could out-think its opponents was more likely to succeed in battle and would then pass on the genes responsible for this mental advantage to its offspring. You and I are the descendants of the winners.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: accordingly=그에 따라 (적의 공격을 예측하고 '그에 따라' 계획한다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① immediately: immediately(즉시)는 시간의 의미로 '그에 맞춰'라는 맥락과 다름
❌ ② randomly: randomly(무작위로)는 예측에 따라 계획한다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ accordingly: 원문 일치. 적의 공격 시점·장소를 예측하고 그에 따라(accordingly) 계획한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ secretly: secretly(은밀히)는 '예측에 맞춰'라는 맥락과 다름
det.tip: plan accordingly = 그에 따라 계획하다

The human mind became a weapon in the struggle for survival, a weapon far more decisive than any before it. And this mental advantage was applied, over and over, within each succeeding generation. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: more likely to=~할 가능성이 더 높은 (상대를 능가하는 부족은 전투에서 성공할 가능성이 더 높다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① far less able to(~할 능력이 훨씬 덜한): 성공 가능성이 높다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② quite unwilling to(~하기를 꽤 꺼리는): 전투에서 성공한다는 맥락과 어긋남
❌ ③ always afraid to(항상 ~하기 두려운): 성공 가능성 맥락과 반대
✅ ④ more likely to: 원문 일치. 상대를 능가하는 부족은 전투에서 성공할 가능성이 더 높다(more likely to succeed)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: be more likely to + 동사원형 = ~할 가능성이 더 높다
